## Pull request overview

Enhances the DetailView experience across the platform by better consuming the existing view schema capabilities (sections, responsive layout, header semantics) and improving common field renderers, with corresponding test + Storybook coverage.

**Changes:**
- Extend `@object-ui/types` DetailView schemas with `hideEmpty`, `primaryField`, and `summaryFields`.
- Update `@object-ui/plugin-detail` rendering: hide empty fields/sections, improve header title + badges, and adjust responsive breakpoints; add `collapseWhenEmpty` behavior to activity timeline.
- Enhance `@object-ui/fields` cell renderers (email/phone copy UX, boolean status warning badge) and update console’s RecordDetailView to respect form section grouping + inferred layout.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 14 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 9 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/views.ts | Adds new DetailView schema surface (`hideEmpty`, `primaryField`, `summaryFields`). |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailSection.tsx | Implements hide-empty filtering and updates grid breakpoint classes. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx | Renders primary-field header title and summary-field badges. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx | Adds `collapseWhenEmpty` option to suppress empty-state message. |
| apps/console/src/components/RecordDetailView.tsx | Generates grouped sections from `objectDef.views.form.sections` and infers `primaryField`. |
| packages/fields/src/index.tsx | Adds email/phone copy affordances and boolean status “Off” warning badge behavior. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/autoLayout.test.ts | Adds regression coverage for undefined `columns`. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailSection.test.tsx | Updates breakpoint assertions and adds hideEmpty behavior tests. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.test.tsx | Adds tests for `primaryField` and `summaryFields` header rendering. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordActivityTimeline.test.tsx | Adds test coverage for `collapseWhenEmpty`. |
| packages/fields/src/__tests__/cell-renderers.test.tsx | Adds/updates tests for new email/phone renderers + boolean warning badge. |
| packages/fields/src/__tests__/boolean-checkbox.test.tsx | Adjusts checkbox tests to account for status-field warning badge behavior. |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.stories.tsx | Adds stories demonstrating primaryField/badges and hideEmpty sections. |
| ROADMAP.md | Updates roadmap with March 2026 DetailView optimization entry. |
</details>

The copy button is only revealed on hover (`opacity-0` + `group-hover/...:opacity-100`), which makes it hard/impossible to discover via keyboard navigation. Add focus styling (e.g. `focus-visible:opacity-100`) and ensure it’s reachable/visible when tabbed to.
```suggestion
        className="opacity-0 group-hover/email:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 transition-opacity p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-muted focus-visible:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background"
```

`collapseWhenEmpty` is documented as “collapse to only the comment input when there are no items”, but the implementation only hides the "No activity recorded" message; the CardHeader/filter chrome still renders. Either update the prop documentation to match behavior or extend the conditional rendering to actually collapse the header/filter/content when empty.

The phone copy button is hover-only (`opacity-0` + `group-hover/...:opacity-100`), which is not keyboard-discoverable. Add `focus-visible` (and/or always-visible on keyboard focus) so keyboard users can find and use it.
```suggestion
        className="opacity-0 group-hover/phone:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 transition-opacity p-0.5 rounded hover:bg-muted focus-visible:bg-muted focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-background"
```

In the form-sections path, `objectDef.fields[fieldName]` assumes `objectDef.fields` is always defined, but this file elsewhere treats it as optional (`objectDef.fields || {}`). If metadata can omit `fields`, this will throw. Use a safe fallback (e.g. `objectDef.fields?.[fieldName]`) and ensure the missing-field fallback still provides a default `type` so downstream renderers behave consistently.
